name: campfire_crackle
prompt: A small driftwood campfire on a beach at night heard close from one metre: soft irregular crackling and small wood pops, gentle low flutter of flames, quiet glowing coals, steady and calm. Only the fire, no waves, no wind, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: campfire_flare
prompt: A campfire burning brightly after fresh dry wood was added, a soft continuous low roar and flutter of flames with dense crackling and snapping, heard close. Only the fire, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: campfire_log_shift
prompt: A burning log in a small campfire slowly shifts and settles, charred wood knocks softly and glowing embers tumble and tinkle, a short burst of crackling, then quiet. Single event, close, no music, no voices, dry.

name: campfire_damp_hiss
prompt: Damp driftwood in a campfire: steam hissing and softly whistling from the end of a wet log, sputtering and fizzing for a few seconds, then fading. Single event, close, no music, no voices, dry.

name: shore_wave
prompt: One small wave breaking on a pebble beach at night, a soft splash, the wash running up the shingle, then the pebbles rattling and clattering as the water drains back, fading. Single wave, heard from a few metres up the beach, no seagulls, no wind, no music, no voices, dry.

name: shore_breakers_far
prompt: Field recording at night: gentle ocean waves breaking one after another along a long shingle and sand beach, heard from thirty metres up the beach, a soft continuous wash of surf with slow swells, calm, natural ambience. No music, no voices, no seagulls, no wind noise.

name: shore_breakers_far
prompt: Gentle ocean surf along a long beach at night heard from thirty metres away, a soft continuous wash of small waves breaking one after another, steady and calm. Only the sea, no seagulls, no wind, no music, no voices, dry.

name: shore_curlew
prompt: A single Eurasian curlew calling far away across a beach at night, a soft rising bubbling whistle 'cur-lee' carried over the water, then silence. Only the bird, distant, no other birds, no music, no voices, dry.

name: shore_bell_buoy
prompt: A bell buoy far out at sea at night, a few slow irregular soft clangs of a bronze bell as the swell rocks it, faint and distant, with silence between them. Only the bell, no waves, no music, no voices, dry, single source.
